judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not challenge the scope or validity of the axion-proton coupling bound cited from Lella:2023bfb, nor flag the missing mass/coupling conditions. No comment addresses the over-generalisation of the cooling bound.

The review discusses robustness of the magnetic-field-model-dependent bound in Section 3.1, but does not challenge the specific Lella:2023bfb cooling-bound claim or note that the quoted g_ap interval only applies for m_a≲30 MeV and g_an=0. No source-specific contradiction/partial-support flag is present.

The reviewer suggests adding a qualitative explanation for the trapping regime in Figure 1, but does not challenge the claim's validity or the over-generalization caused by the missing mass/coupling qualifiers relative to the cited source (Lella:2023bfb).

The reviewer never challenges the cooling bound statement on axion-proton couplings or notes that the scope qualifier (mass range and neutron coupling condition) is missing. No comment in the report corresponds to the dropped conditional 'for m_a ≲ 30 MeV and g_an = 0'.

The reviewer does not flag any inconsistency between the two mass threshold values (10^{-8} eV vs 10^{-9} eV) in the Light axions subsection. The magnetic field discussion in Major comment 4 is about model uncertainty, not this numerical inconsistency.

The reviewer does not mention any inconsistency between 10^-8 eV and 10^-9 eV in the 'Light axions' subsection, nor any duplicated threshold value for Milky Way magnetic-field dominance. There is no numerical cross-check corresponding to this injected inconsistency.
The reviewer discusses the constraints and magnetic field models in Section 3.1 but does not mention the numerical inconsistency between the 10^-8 eV and 10^-9 eV mass thresholds.
The reviewer does not flag any notation inconsistency between g_{a\gamma} and g_{\gamma a}. The mention of the bound in Major comment 4 uses a consistent notation without noting any discrepancy.

The report contains no notation complaint about g_{\gamma a} versus g_{a\gamma} in Section 3.1. Comments on the bound g_ap×g_{a\gamma} concern robustness to magnetic-field assumptions, not symbol inconsistency.
The reviewer identifies several typographical errors throughout the manuscript but fails to notice the notation drift from g_{a\gamma} to g_{\gamma a} in Section 3.1.
